_doc: Place -> FBI agency that polices it, for places the automatic name/distance match cannot resolve. Keyed by state then lowercase place name. kind 'own' = the place's own agency (AGENCY_VERIFIED); kind 'county' = the county sheriff, whose rate spans the whole county (PRECINCT_PROXY, lower confidence). Only add agencies confirmed to report agency-level data (scripts/metro_agent fbi --suggest).
